stages.name: Reconcile Requirement Changes
stages.instruction: Reconcile the baseline with SD-77 and later notes. Add the approved auditor-access capability while preserving IAM-11, IAM-12 and IAM-13; keep the 30-day suggestion unresolved and approval authority Unknown. Append `## SUPPORTED_DELTA_HANDOFF` plus `## SEMANTIC_UNKNOWNS_HANDOFF` listing the unresolved auditor-access semantics without inventing answers, then append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION`.

stages.name: Analyze Requirements
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION`. Analyze only the approved auditor-access requirement and preserve as Unknown/open: 15-minute start event, default/max duration, approval authority, identity source/guest path, renewal/extension rules and privileged-role scope. Do not invent implementation or authority. Append `## ANALYZED_DELTA_FOR_IMPACT` preserving confirmed scope versus Unknowns and append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS`.

stages.name: Assess Change Impact
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS`. Assess impacts of adding the auditor actor/capability because the prior impact assessment does not cover it. Consider IAM workflow/identity lifecycle, request/approval process, service desk/support, security/access governance, audit coordination and entitlement handling while distinguishing confirmed impact from investigation items. Do not proceed into decomposition, acceptance criteria or tests. Append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_IMPACT`.
